name: self marked text
description: a long text entry question where the user checks off the parts they have got correct. Relies on the ed devs writing the correct answer in a very specific way

hint.value: You should write your answer as a sentence, paragraph or short essay, depending onhte amount of inforamtion teh question requires. When you are done hit 'compare' to check your answer.

marking_script:
mark:
switch(
  interpreted_answer = input_options['howManyChecks'],
            correct(input_options['correctFeedback']),
  interpreted_answer >0,
  set_credit(credit, input_options['partialCorrect']),
  incorrect("You awarded yourself 0 marks for your answer"+ input_options['incorrectFeedback'])            
)

interpreted_answer:
decimal(studentAnswer)

credit:
if (interpreted_answer> 0,interpreted_answer/marks, 0)

marking_notes.name: interpreted_answer
marking_notes.description: A value representing the student's answer to this part.

settings.name: modelAnswer
settings.label: Model answer with points for student to check off
settings.hint:
The model answer should show the student what they should have put. Points that would get the student marks should have a [check] next to them. Each [check] will be replaced with a checkbox for the student to use for marking. You can have more checks than marks- e.g. if you ahve 3 checks, 2 marks and a marking increment of 1 then any 2 or more out of 3 will get full marks.

Remember if the format is you could have this OR this and that OR that (2 marks) then checks need to go here: pigs OR hogs [check]; cows or cattle[check];
settings.default_value: This answer will get a point [check], so will this [check] and this [check]

settings.name: howManyChecks
settings.label: How many answers must the user get to be correct
settings.hint: E.g. if the correct answer is nay ONE of the following then they need to get 1, if there is a list of 5 and any 3 would do, then 3 and so on- think about how many checks you have inserted in the answer and how many of these the user must tick to be correct.

settings.name: markIncrement
settings.label: How much each tick is worth
settings.hint: E.g. if this is one and there are 5 checkboxes, then the user will get 1 mark for each point up to a maximum of 'marks' for the part

settings.name: rows
settings.label: Text entry height in rows
settings.hint: Text entry height is set in rows

settings.name: howTo
settings.label: instruction for user
settings.default_value: This is a self marked question. You should write your answer as one or more sentences. When you are ready use the button to 'Check your answer'.

settings.name: markInstruction
settings.label: User instruction for marking
settings.hint: Tell the user how to work the markking part of the question.
settings.default_value: Tick each of the items that matches something in your answer. Or choose 'I did not get the correct answer(s)'. When you have finished click 'Save answer'

settings.name: correctFeedback
settings.label: Feedback if the user is correct

settings.name: partialCorrect
settings.label: Feedback message if the user is partially correct

settings.name: incorrectFeedback
settings.label: Feedback message for the wrong answer
settings.hint: this allows you to give user advice on what to look for if they got teh wrong answer
settings.default_value: You did not get any marks this time. You might want to revise [topic]
